text: The parity machine tracks whether the count of 1s is even or odd rather than counting them. Why does that matter?
choices: It needs one bit of memory regardless of input length, so it scales
Counting would give the wrong answer
It is faster to compute parity than to count
explanation: A machine that counted would need memory growing with the input; tracking parity needs one bit forever. Both answer the question and only one scales. Choosing what to remember is choosing what your program can afford.
